You see Chief Grarkharok.
  • Grarkharok's bestest troll tribe! Yeee, good name!
  • Grarkharok make new tribe here! Me Chief now!
  • Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!

Location

The mountains north of Edron.

Notes

He would like a wife to start a tribe with.Part of the Troll Sabotage Quest and the Threatened Dreams Quest.
